title: pseudognaphalium stramineum
intro: Pseudognaphalium stramineum, commonly known as straw bent or strammonium, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Pseudognaphalium stramineum are attributed to its ability to act as a bitter and astringent, helping to stimulate digestion and relieve gastrointestinal discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Pseudognaphalium stramineum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
